## Process Meeting Pipeline

1. Webhook Trigger (`job_id`)
2. Validate Job & Audio on shared filesystem (`/data/jobs/<job_id>`)
3. Update status = 'transcribing'
4. Call Deepgram (Multichannel + Diarization)
5. Normalize to Transcript Contract
6. Update status = 'analyzing'
7. Call Gemini Flash (Structured JSON Schema)
8. Validate MeetingData Contract
9. Write `result.json` & update status = 'completed'
10. Trigger Cleanup Workflow
